systems.country_label: SICOLO, portal digital del ecosistema educativo (sicoloeg.com)
systems.owner: not stated; the article speaks only of the platform's promoters
systems.tiers: public web portal launched in Malabo on 17 July 2026; parents and guardians fill an online enrolment form for schools and nurseries; also a directory of institutions, school performance, UNGE selectividad results and a graduate-profile database

note: No fact: SICOLO is a portal where parents submit enrolment forms and results are published; the article states no record per learner that schools add to, no link to the ministry and no owner, so it is not class emis.
